div.p: The craft
div.h2: Maize, heat, and a pipe shape.
div.p: Acharya Dhunro Pasal puffs traditional, non-hybrid maize into airy pipes — a familiar teatime snack with a clean crunch and a golden finish.
Batches stay small so the crunch stays even. Ask for a bag for the house, a pack for the gathering, or a sack if you sell snacks of your own.
